_note: The tenant directory the platform holds. The subject half of every decision input is assembled from here and from the envelope's own delegation chain - never from a member a caller filled in - so a caller cannot shape the question it will be judged on. An acting subject with no row here is refused before any decision is asked for: an unknown principal is not a principal with no mandates. Proposed: a directory file is this example's stand-in for whatever holds tenancy in a real deployment.
